facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold (three-quarters price) for their barrow treasure once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
The party owes the wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note for joining the party; the exact split was not stated.
Cedric cannot pay the note until his supply caravans resume; shipments stopped when the dragon troubles began.
